revoked.title: Restore from a revoked server
revoked.since: {{server}} was revoked on {{date}}. If it was compromised before then, snapshots it uploaded after that could contain altered data. Choose one recorded before you think the compromise began. A restore is checked, but the checks can't tell a tampered snapshot from a genuine one.
revoked.sinceUnknown: {{server}} is revoked, and when its revocation began wasn't recorded. If it was compromised, snapshots it uploaded could contain altered data. Choose one recorded before you think the compromise began. A restore is checked, but the checks can't tell a tampered snapshot from a genuine one.
revoked.frozen: Nothing backs up to or prunes this policy's repository any more. For ongoing backups, create a policy on the environment's current server: it gets a new repository with its own key.
revoked.history: The runs below are as the revoked server reported them, including whether a restore was verified. Nothing has checked them.

picker.none: Astilba recorded no snapshot from this server that is still available. A snapshot the server never reported can only be restored by hand, as the backups guide describes.
picker.recordedBefore: Recorded by Astilba on {{date}}, {{duration}} before the revocation
picker.claimed: The server says this backup started on {{date}}.
picker.acknowledge: I understand that a snapshot this server uploaded could contain altered data that the restore's checks can't detect.
picker.started: Restore started. Nothing uses the new volume until you prepare and deploy a cutover.

restores.title: Restores
restores.cutoverHint: A cutover switches the deployment to this snapshot's data. Writes made since the snapshot aren't included. Review the downtime before you apply the deployment.
restores.cutoverDirty: Save or discard your configuration changes before you prepare a cutover.
restores.cutoverSaved: Cutover saved as a draft. Prepare and review a deployment plan to switch storage.
restores.cutoverConflict: Cutover saved. Your newer edits were kept; resolve the revision conflict before you deploy.
restores.discardDescription: This deletes volume {{volume}}, which the restore created on the environment's current server. It can't be undone, and the restore can't be cut over afterwards.
restores.discardQueued: Discard queued. The volume is removed once the server confirms it.
restores.discardPending: Discarding the volume. It is deleted once the server confirms.

exposed.policy: A revoked server was given this destination's storage keys. It can still delete or overwrite these backups until you revoke the keys at your storage provider. For backups it can't reach, add a destination with new keys and create a policy on it.
exposed.warning: A revoked server was given this destination's storage keys. It can still delete or overwrite anything written here until you revoke them at your storage provider.
exposed.acknowledge: I understand that the revoked server can delete or overwrite this policy's backups until its keys are revoked at the provider.
